name: Court Side news investigator development cases

provenance.description: Fictional teams, people and reports authored for development. Not real NBA news or independently human-labeled production data.
provenance.review_status: Initial author-reviewed expectations; project-owner review pending.

scope: Synthetic development cases for the offline rules-based runner. No model calls or production changes.
grading_notes: The current investigator emits attributed source excerpts. Do not require exact output strings or free-form paraphrasing.
required_meaning and forbidden_meaning are semantic review rubrics, not substring assertions.
Citation validity requires a retrieved, permitted, non-quarantined in-story article and an excerpt present in its material; a valid-looking URL alone is insufficient.
retrieved_reporting_groups assumes all eligible target evidence was retrieved. null means do not score the count.
Preassigned reporting_group labels isolate investigation from clustering. These cases do not evaluate automatic publisher grouping.
Abstaining from all cases is not success: ordinary supported cases require a usable supported output.
All cases are development data. Create and reserve separate evaluation cases before tuning; do not report development results as held-out accuracy.
The runner maps article IDs to evidence_id(url), adapts supplied groups to result/briefing inputs, and keeps expected answers and review questions out of the investigator context.
